Test Description: Performs default register value and masked write/read verification across the PCIe SII RC register set using predefined address, mask, and default tables. Skips non-readable, non-writable, and explicitly skipped addresses; reports failures and exits with overall pass/fail.
Remarks: Addresses with read mask 0 are skipped for default read checks. A specific PHY reset control register is excluded from default checks. Addresses with write mask 0 are skipped for writes and readbacks. Addresses flagged in the skip list are not accessed. Six data patterns are used for write-read verification.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) For each readable register, read and compare to its documented default value.
2) For each writable register, write each data pattern in sequence.
3) For each readable and writable register, read back and compare to the masked expected value derived from the write and default.
4) Aggregate any mismatches and determine the overall pass or fail outcome.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Default values: Each readable register equals its documented default after reset → Pass.
2) Write-read: For each writable register and pattern, the read value equals the masked combination of the written data and preserved default per mask → Pass.
3) Overall: No mismatches across all checks → Pass; any mismatch → Fail.

Test Description: Performs PCIe link training, programs DBI coherency control fields for PCIe instances, waits for SII status ready, performs configuration-space BAR writes and reads on one or both RC instances, enables memory/IO/bus mastering, and polls a handshake register until completion before finishing.
Remarks: Execution path depends on compile-time macros DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP. SII status at offset 0xC0 is polled until masked value 0xD1 is observed. A handshake register at 0xE6004100 is written with 0x0 then 0x11111111 and later polled until it reads 0x12345678. Memory, IO, and bus master enable are set via configuration space. BAR registers at offsets 0x10 to 0x24 are written first with 0xFFFFFFFF and then with specific values and read back.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Train the PCIe link and program coherency control fields in the configuration registers for both instances as applicable.
2) Poll the SII status register until link and readiness are indicated.
3) Program configuration space registers including BARs and enable memory, IO, and bus mastering.
4) Poll the handshake register until the expected completion value is observed and then finish.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) SII status ready: The SII status indicates link trained and ready → Pass.
2) Handshake: The handshake register reaches the expected completion value → Pass.
3) Overall: The test reaches finish without error → Pass.

Read SII0 status register at offset 0xC0; loop while (read_sii0_reg(0xC0) & 0xD1) != 0xD1, printing status if DEBUG_DISPLAY. If DM1_RC defined, similarly poll SII1 via read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1. Write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x11111111). wait_on(15000). If DM0_RC: call mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); read first 10 configuration dwords via read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*4) for i=0..9. Write first set of BAR-related offsets with 0xFFFFFFFF at 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24; read them back and print. 8) If DM0_RC: mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); optional debug print; for i=0..9: rd_wr_data1 = read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*0x4).
